If enabled, the system will watch the login attempts of every account and will block that account after a given number of consecutive failed logins for a given amount of time. maxClientAliveMessages.description: Sets the number of client alive messages which may be sent without sshd receiving any messages back from the client. If this threshold is reached while client alive messages are being sent, sshd will disconnect the client, terminating the session. The client alive mechanism is valuable when the client or server depend on knowing when a connection has become inactive.

noProbingInterfaces.description: Exclude all gateways reachable through these interfaces from regular ICMP based probing.

startInterval.description: Interval in seconds [1-60] for polling network routes and the HA partner upon startup (default: 10). Higher values result in an increased acquisition time.

regularInterval.description: Interval in seconds [1-10] for polling network routes and the HA partner (default: 5). Lower values will result in faster failover but also more traffic and load.

icmpProbeTime.description: Period in seconds in which the successful and unsuccessful ICMP echoes will be counted (default: 15). This period has to be greater than the Regular Poll Interval.

icmpProbeLoss.description: Defines how many ICMP echoes can be lost in percent.
